title: Hively and Woodside paper on extended electrodynamics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hively and Woodside paper on extended electrodynamics, about unspecified at Colorado Springs; Australia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Lee Hiveley uh in Colorado Springs and he has a a colleague named Woodside who I believe is in Australia

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode featuring the thinker Eric Weinstein and a Pentagon scientist, points to a paper on extended electrodynamics, a broader version of the physics of electricity and magnetism. Michels says it was written by a man named Lee Hively in Colorado Springs and a colleague named Woodside who, he believes, is in Australia, and he raises it as physics worth a look in the UFO debate.
